title: [CQ-M07s] moe-agent.ps1: under verified-local, a worktree completion runs its owed checks in check VMs (twin of CQ-M07r)
description:
Slice of CQ-M07 (task-1a8f1d0e199046a289e94a5453d758b8, the final acceptance row). Filed by its planner architect-c33f294e on 2026-11-04. This is the PowerShell twin of CQ-M07r (task-ba7a8c84fff44b95bf04c829791db935). It depends on CQ-M07r because it ports that row's landed behavior, codes and strings, and reuses its fake dispatch CLI scripts/tests/postflight-fake-check-dispatch.js. Design: mem:decision-cq-m07-verified-local-activation. Under verified-local, Windows worker and QA seats run only this wrapper, natively (decision 3), so this half is the one the JetBrains route actually launches.

OBJECTIVE. Port CQ-M07r to scripts/moe-agent.ps1. Under the strong profile, L6 of a worktree completion (Invoke-MoeWorktreeRounds, where Invoke-MoeFrozenGate -WorktreeMode runs today):
- records the frozen candidate of M on B as today;
- builds one never-published commit with tree M and the single parent B;
- runs the bundled local-runner\check-dispatch.mjs with --project <control checkout> --task <taskId> --commit <that commit>;
- goes on to L7 only on exit 0.
Every other result is MOE_COMMIT_FAILED_GATE with the same line as sh. The host never runs the qualityGate command for a strong task. legacy, observe and task-less landings keep Invoke-MoeFrozenGate -WorktreeMode byte for byte. The MOE_CHECK_DISPATCH_PATH override is ignored under MOE_RUNTIME_PROTECTED=1, as in sh.

DELIVERABLE
- scripts/moe-agent.ps1, kept UTF-8 with a BOM.
- New rows in scripts/tests/postflight-vm-route.ps1.
- scripts/tests/parity-check.sh and scripts/tests/parity-check.ps1 compare any code family CQ-M07r introduced.

NOT IN SCOPE: moe-agent.sh (CQ-M07r); delivery receipts (CQ-M07t); daemon, local-runner and docs changes.

PLANNER NOTES: mem:gotcha-qa-ps1-postflight-from-wsl, mem:decision-ps1-harness-pin-inline-wrapper-block, mem:gotcha-wrapper-slice-tests-execute-text and mem:gotcha-windows-python-text-mode-crlf-in-node-tests. Run every ps1 gate under both Windows PowerShell 5.1 and pwsh 7. No seat runs Multipass.

VERIFICATION, from the task worktree with MOE_*/CLAUDE*/FAKE_* scrubbed and MOE_POSTFLIGHT_TIMEOUT_SEC=360 (WSLENV=MOE_POSTFLIGHT_TIMEOUT_SEC): run `pwsh.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File '<D:\ worktree path>\scripts\tests\postflight.ps1'`, then the same with powershell.exe, then `bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh && npm run lint`.
definitionOfDone: Under verified-local, the ps1 worktree completion's L6 runs check-dispatch.mjs on a commit of exactly M with the single parent B, and never runs the qualityGate on the host. The same canary-gate row as CQ-M07r passes on PS 5.1 and pwsh 7.
CQ-M07r's non-pass cases each fail as MOE_COMMIT_FAILED_GATE, with nothing published and lines byte-identical to sh. One postflight-vm-route.ps1 row per case.

legacy, observe and task-less ps1 completions run Invoke-MoeFrozenGate -WorktreeMode unchanged: the existing postflight-worktree.cjs and postflight-vm-route.ps1 rows pass with their assertions unedited.
parity-check.sh and parity-check.ps1 both pass and compare any code family CQ-M07r introduced. A renamed new code fails both. moe-agent.ps1 still starts with the bytes ef bb bf.
postflight.ps1 passes under PS 5.1 and pwsh 7 from the task worktree, and so does `npm run lint`.
taskRails: Never run a verified-local task's qualityGate or any candidate code on the host. When the check VMs cannot run the owed checks, refuse the landing.
No seat runs Multipass: tests use the fake dispatch CLI only.

implementationPlan.note:
PORT CONTRACT (from 9e9e7345; R's round 2 not landed at 15:40Z, target tip = 9e9e7345).
Codes, all family MOE_CHECK_DISPATCH_ (parity compares none yet): env PATH, TIMEOUT_SEC; warning PATH_IGNORED; line REFUSED; verdicts UNAVAILABLE, TIMEOUT_INVALID, TIMEOUT, NO_REPORT, REPLY_INVALID, NOT_PASSED. Child fixed codes pass through (stopped.code first, then top-level code).
Warning (stderr, verbatim): `[WARN] MOE_CHECK_DISPATCH_PATH_IGNORED: MOE_CHECK_DISPATCH_PATH is ignored under MOE_RUNTIME_PROTECTED=1; only the bundled local-runner/check-dispatch.mjs runs.` Resolver default <scripts>/local-runner/check-dispatch.mjs; override honored only unprotected.
L6: `if gate && taskId && strong` -> freeze (New-MoeFrozenCandidate + Send-MoeCandidate) && dispatch, else MOE_COMMIT_FAILED_GATE msg `the merged tree $m on $b was not frozen, recorded and passed by the check VMs (<code or 'no dispatch'>[ environment=<id>])`; legacy `if` becomes `elseif`, body unchanged. Dispatched commit = the frozen candidate's commit (commit-tree M -p B, 'Moe frozen candidate snapshot'); no second commit-tree (ps1 G8 forbids 'commit-tree' text before the intent call).
Dispatch order: Rel -> existing MOE_WORKTREE_PROJECT_NOT_TOP line + code; bound Get-MoeLandLeaseBudget(MOE_CHECK_DISPATCH_TIMEOUT_SEC or 3600) else TIMEOUT_INVALID; no node / no CLI file -> UNAVAILABLE; spawn node CLI --project <projectPath> --task <id> --commit <frozen commit>, 5 credentials + GIT_INDEX_FILE/GIT_DIR/GIT_WORK_TREE/GIT_COMMON_DIR removed, stdin empty, stdout to a file, stderr discarded; cyan `Post-flight: owed checks in check VMs: task <id> candidate <cand>`; poll to the bound; timeout -> stop, TIMEOUT; else verdict. PASS -> green `[OK] check VMs passed every owed check of candidate <cand>.`; else one stderr `[WARN] MOE_CHECK_DISPATCH_REFUSED: <verdict>`.
Verdict (python port): read <=1048577 bytes; missing/empty NO_REPORT; >1 MiB BAD; strict UTF-8; drop exactly ONE trailing \n; any \n or \r left BAD; JSON object else BAD; 'stopped' key -> its code must fullmatch [A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,63} else BAD, plus ' environment=<e>' only on fullmatch moe-local-vm-v1:[0-9a-f]{64}; 'code' key -> fixed code else BAD; taskId/candidateId equal and results a list else BAD; rc!=0 NOT_PASSED; non-empty results PASS else BAD. Keys case-sensitive.
Stop (sh): TERM group once, 120 s grace, KILL, pid cleared LAST; EXIT trap (cleanup_temp) stops a running dispatch.
WINDOWS DEVIATION (no TERM exists that the wrapper could send to the child alone; node raises SIGTERM never, and check-dispatch.mjs handles only SIGINT/SIGTERM): the child shares the wrapper's console, so an operator Ctrl+C reaches it once as SIGINT. The wrapper never signals it: Stop-MoeCheckDispatch waits a grace for it to exit, then `taskkill /T /F /PID <recorded pid>`, record cleared last. Grace 120 s on the interrupt paths (invoker finally, outer finally after Stop-MoeGateChild), 0 on the timeout (nothing was delivered, so waiting is pointless). A timed-out check VM can therefore leak on Windows: I will file a bug for a Windows stop seam in check-dispatch.mjs (out of scope: no local-runner change).
sh rows to mirror: SG-pass/legacy/observe/nonzero/stopped/nothing-owed/undeclared/crash/unparsable/env/env-malformed/missing/timeout/protected (E2E, codex VM worker, OPENAI_API_KEY, FAKE_TASK_STATUS=REVIEW, FAKE_ATTEMPT_PROFILE, canary qualityGate witness); SGV verdict table (+ round-2 D: pass+"\n\n" BAD, E: results {"outcome":"passed"} rc0 BAD); SGU U1-U7 (U7 ported as a runspace Stop() mid-dispatch: the PipelineStoppedException a Ctrl+C raises); SG8 static if/elseif order; round-2 G = static order pin of the outer finally (Stop-MoeCheckDispatch after Stop-MoeGateChild, before Invoke-MoeTeardownRescue and Complete-MoePostflight).
Parity: R added the MOE_CHECK_DISPATCH_ family sh-only; step 4 adds it to both scripts plus require_both literals.

moe-agent.ps1 runtime: the check-VM gate at L6 under the strong profile. Keep the file UTF-8 with a BOM, and edit it in place in the task worktree with the editing tool (scripts/CLAUDE.md: never a shell write).

(a) RESOLVER, next to $script:AgentSeatCli (about line 9398):
- `$script:CheckDispatchCli = Join-Path $script:MoeScriptRoot 'local-runner\check-dispatch.mjs'`;
- MOE_CHECK_DISPATCH_PATH is honored only when -not $script:MoeRuntimeProtected. Under it, write R's exact warning to stderr.

(b) INVOKER, modeled on Invoke-MoeSeatCli (about line 9405):
- the same credential scrub before node runs (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN, CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, OPENAI_API_KEY, CODEX_API_KEY), restored in finally;
- the same UTF-8 pipe and console encodings for PS 5.1;
- only stdout captured, $LASTEXITCODE kept;
- the time bound from the port contract. Stop a child that outlives it by its recorded process id only, never by name.

(c) L6 in Invoke-MoeWorktreeRounds (about lines 7381-7399):
- When Test-MoeStrongLandingTask $preflightTaskId $Git.GitDir is true: keep `New-MoeFrozenCandidate $Git $m $b` and Send-MoeCandidate as today. Then `git commit-tree $m -p $b` with R's identity and message choice. Then the dispatch: `--project <control top> --task $preflightTaskId --commit <that commit>`.
- ConvertFrom-Json reads the one line for fixed codes only.
- Exit 0 with every owed check passed: continue to Test-MoeWorktreeStrongIntent with that frozen candidate.
- Any other result: $Res.Code = 'MOE_COMMIT_FAILED_GATE', with R's exact $L.Msg. Append environment=<id> only when the stop's environment matches ^moe-local-vm-v1:[0-9a-f]{64}$ exactly (-cmatch). Return $false.
- Error handling: a missing CLI, a spawn failure, a timeout, a non-JSON or multi-line reply and a commit-tree failure each fail the round the same way, with nothing published and no credential in the child.
- An interrupt during the dispatch fails the round. The existing Ctrl+C deferral and the finally block must not record a host-gate CheckRun for a gate that never ran.

(d) LEGACY. Every non-strong path (legacy, observe, task-less) keeps today's Invoke-MoeFrozenGate -WorktreeMode branch byte for byte. Under the strong branch the host Invoke-MoeFrozenGate is never called.

(e) PS 5.1 SYNTAX: no `??`, ternary `? :` or `&&`/`||` pipeline-chain operators; ParseFile must parse cleanly on 5.1 and 7.

Parity. CQ-M07r may have added its codes in a family parity-check does not compare yet, to keep its own sh-only landing green. If so, add that family, and any new required literal (the env var name, the warning text), to BOTH scripts/tests/parity-check.sh and scripts/tests/parity-check.ps1, so that sh and ps1 must carry the same set from now on. implementationPlan.description:
Verification, once, from the task worktree: run checkRefs[0] exactly. It runs postflight.ps1 under pwsh.exe, then powershell.exe (5.1), with MOE_*/CLAUDE*/FAKE_* scrubbed and MOE_POSTFLIGHT_TIMEOUT_SEC=360, then parity-check.sh, parity-check.ps1 and npm run lint.
- It takes up to about 1h45m under load. Start it detached (nohup, record $!) and poll with bounded until-loops (mem:gotcha-qa-ps1-postflight-from-wsl). Kill only that recorded PID.
- A `UtilAcceptVsock` WSL error with no harness output is an interop flake: rerun the leg.
- On a red row, rerun the same leg on the target's bytes before blaming this change.
- complete_task's verification is this command. The summary gives each engine's section counts (frozen, owner, migration, worktree, vm-route) and every new [strong gate] row's result.

Adversarial self-review of this diff, the final step. Use the adversarial-self-review skill.

(1) Byte parity: diff every new literal in moe-agent.ps1 against the port contract. Any drift from sh is a defect.
(2) Legacy: every hunk in Invoke-MoeWorktreeRounds is under the strong branch. Show the non-strong path's lines unchanged in `git diff -U0`.
(3) Host never runs candidate code: no Invoke-MoeFrozenGate call and no qualityGate command can be reached under strong. Grep the strong branch.
(4) The invoker on every exit path: credentials are restored, encodings are restored, the child is stopped by recorded PID on timeout or Ctrl+C, and a stale $LASTEXITCODE from an earlier command is never read as the dispatch's.
(5) Inputs: a JSON line with extra keys, a huge line, an environment with uppercase hex or a trailing newline. Each fails closed or prints nothing extra.
(6) Concurrency: two strong completions racing on the land lease each dispatch their own commit, and a round-2 retry re-dispatches for the new M. It never reuses the round-1 verdict.

Fix any finding in this row's files, and re-run only the affected rows before finishing. A deeper defect gets its own bug row.
